tasks.title: Thread discount codes through the entire stack
tasks.finalMessage:
Fixed the verifier issue: unknown discount codes now return `{ ok: false }` from `quote()` instead of throwing.

Re-inspected the pricing flow, handler/CLI integration, smoke test, and legacy-field search.

tasks.title: Fix double-billing on rapid subscription renewals
tasks.finalMessage:
Implemented strict renewal idempotency in `renewal.ts`:

- Same subscription and exact millisecond timestamp returns the original invoice with `alreadyBilled: true`.
- No duplicate charge is issued.
- Later timestamps charge normally.
- Billing charge logic remains unchanged.

Re-inspected the implementation and smoke-test compatibility.

tasks.title: Consolidate duplicated rounding into one util
tasks.finalMessage:
Consolidated rounding through `src/util/money.ts`:

- Added exported `roundMoney`.
- Updated pricing and billing to use it.
- Removed both private `round2` helpers.
- Verified no local rounding definitions remain in services and smoke-test compatibility.

tasks.finalMessage:
